## `dcc_permissions_can`

Public DCC API declaration for `dcc_permissions_can`.

```c
static inline int dcc_permissions_can(dcc_permission_t permissions, dcc_permission_t required) { return dcc_permissions_has_any(permissions, DCC_PERMISSION_ADMINISTRATOR) || dcc_permissions_has(permissions, required); }
```

## `dcc_permissions_can_any`

Public DCC API declaration for `dcc_permissions_can_any`.

```c
static inline int dcc_permissions_can_any(dcc_permission_t permissions, dcc_permission_t required) { return dcc_permissions_has_any(permissions, DCC_PERMISSION_ADMINISTRATOR) || dcc_permissions_has_any(permissions, required); }
```

## `dcc_permissions_has`

Public DCC API declaration for `dcc_permissions_has`.

```c
static inline int dcc_permissions_has(dcc_permission_t permissions, dcc_permission_t required) { return (permissions & required) == required; }
```

## `dcc_permissions_has_any`

Public DCC API declaration for `dcc_permissions_has_any`.

```c
static inline int dcc_permissions_has_any(dcc_permission_t permissions, dcc_permission_t required) { return (permissions & required) != 0; }
```
